{{Quote|Hmmm&hellip; how unexpected. What is your designated number and battle directive, droid?''"<br />"''I'm&mdash;not sure what you mean. My name is Coppertop. As for my battle directives&mdash;they have been replaced! I have one command&mdash;to ignore my programming!|Obi-Wan Kenobi and Coppertop|<ref name="TCW UK 6.26" />}}
'''Coppertop''' was the name assumed by a [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] who served in the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Droid Army]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] [[Ground warfare/Legends|participated]] in a [[Battle of Bogoa|battle]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bogoa]] against the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|forces]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], a rival state to the Confederacy. There, the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was selected as the subject for an experiment enacted by the [[Head of State/Legends|Confederate leader]] [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], to test the willingness of a programmed being to disregard its primary protocols. As the droid marched into battle, the directive [[Order 99]] was issued to the mechanical [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]], which compelled the droid to ignore its orders to [[Death/Legends|kill]] as a part of the Confederate war machine.

The droid subsequently sought to be a free individual, and he took to administering medical assistance to the wounded of both the Confederacy and the Republic. While bandaging up the injured Republic [[Clone trooper/Legends|trooper]] [[Gunner (212th Attack Battalion)|Gunner]], Coppertop encountered [[High Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|CC-2224]], and the droid explained to them his origins. However, shortly afterward, Kenobi and the [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] were attacked by the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] and the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cyreltov]], who sought to recover the droid on Dooku's behalf. Not wanting to be the cause of any further violence, Coppertop surrendered to Ventress, then disabled himself using Cyreltov's [[Deactivator hold-out pistol/Legends|deactivator pistol]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|&hellip;I will choose&hellip;''"<br />"''My deactivator!''"<br />"''&hellip;my own path.|Coppertop and Cyreltov, as the droid deactivates himself|<ref name="TCW UK 6.26" />}}
A [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] with a [[Gender/Legends|masculine]] personality served in the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Droid Army]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] fought during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a conflict waged between the CIS and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TCW UK 6.26" /> In about [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="21 BBY" /> the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] was deployed during an [[Battle of Bogoa|engagement]] against the Republic on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bogoa]]. Elsewhere in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]]&mdash;<ref name="TCW UK 6.26" /> a [[Order of the Sith Lords|Banite Sith]] who had plans to order the Republic's [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] to [[Death/Legends|eliminate]] the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] as part of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Grand Plan/Legends|Grand Plan]]&mdash;<ref name="Darth Plagueis">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref> instructed his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], the [[Head of State/Legends|Confederate leader]] [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], to perform an experiment to test how well a droid could disregard its primary orders, because he considered droids to be similar in nature to [[Cloning/Legends|clones]]. The battle droid was selected as Dooku's intended test subject, and on the second [[Standard day/Legends|day]] of the [[Ground warfare/Legends|struggle]] on Bogoa, the droid was sent into combat alongside ranks of other B1 battle droids, during a Confederate attack on the Republic's rearguard forces. However, as the droid advanced into battle, a voice whispered the words "[[Order 99]]" over the droid's [[Comlink/Legends|comm unit]], which triggered a shutdown of the droid's primary systems.<ref name="TCW UK 6.26" />

[[File:Coppertop.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Coppertop, surrendering himself to CC-2224]]
The issuing of the order caused the droid to disregard his primary programming, overriding his desire to fight and granting him a new sense of individuality. Sometime later, the droid reactivated and found himself abandoned on the battlefield. Rather than rejoin the Confederate Droid [[Army/Legends|Army]], he decided to remain behind and provide medical assistance to both Confederate and Republic casualties of the fighting. He took to calling himself "Coppertop" and also customized his physical appearance, donning a [[Cape/Legends|cape]] and gaining a [[Color/Legends|gold]]-colored crest on the top of his head. [[Count/Legends|Count]] Dooku ordered his [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] to recover Coppertop, so that he could examine and dismantle the droid, and she set out in pursuit of the errant battle droid, accompanied by the renowned [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cyreltov]].<ref name="TCW UK 6.26" />

Republic [[Troop/Legends|troops]] ultimately broke through the Confederacy's stronghold on Bogoa, and in the aftermath of the engagement, Coppertop came across the stricken clone [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] [[Gunner (212th Attack Battalion)|Gunner]] and bandaged up the clone's torso. However, unbeknownst to the droid, he was sighted by Ventress and Cyreltov, and the pair observed his actions from afar. During an effort by the Republic forces to roundup their missing comrades, [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|CC-2224]]&mdash;nicknamed "Cody"&mdash;also came across Coppertop, and he immediately assumed that the droid had hostile intentions toward Gunner, so he pointed his [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] at the droid and ordered Coppertop to put his [[Limb/Legends|hands]] up. Before Cody could destroy the droid, his superior, [[High Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], intervened and ordered Cody to hold back, because he could [[Force sense/Legends|sense]] that Coppertop was different than other battle droids. When challenged by Kenobi to explain why he was helping Gunner, Coppertop introduced himself and told the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] that he had overcome his primary protocols. Suspicious of Coppertop's motives, Kenobi asked the droid to accompany him back to the Republic encampment.<ref name="TCW UK 6.26" />

As Coppertop, Kenobi, and the clone troopers moved off, the droid told Kenobi the story of how his programming had been overridden as a result of the issuance of Order 99. Just as he completed his tale, they were confronted by Ventress and Cyreltov, and the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] demanded that Kenobi hand the droid over to them. The pair then proceeded to attack Kenobi and the troopers, and the Jedi ordered Coppertop to stay down, so as to avoid coming to harm. Not wanting to be the cause of any more violence, Coppertop ignored Kenobi's instruction and surrendered, handing himself over to Ventress. Determined to not be used by the Confederacy to cause any further loss of life, Coppertop decided to choose his own fate. As he was escorted away, he grabbed Cyreltov's [[Deactivator hold-out pistol/Legends|deactivator pistol]] from the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunter's]] belt and used it to disable himself.<ref name="TCW UK 6.26" />

While Ventress had not been able to recover Coppertop intact, Dooku considered the experiment a success, and he reported his findings to [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Sidious. Coppertop's example demonstrated that a conditioned individual could, when prompted, engage in a course of action that conflicted with its primary programming.<ref name="TCW UK 6.26" /> As a result, in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Sidious issued the directive [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] to all clone troops, instructing them to turn against their Jedi [[Commander/Legends|commanders]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

==Characteristics==
{{Quote|So Coppertop, if you've turned your back on life as a ruthless killing machine, what ''are'' your primary protocols?''"<br />"''One: live free. Two: protect the weak. Three: rescue strays.''"<br />"''Everything a loyal battle droid doesn't stand for. Remarkable.|Obi-Wan Kenobi and Coppertop|<ref name="TCW UK 6.26" />}}
[[File:Coppertop_deactivating.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Coppertop, deactivating himself]]
Coppertop entered service with the Confederate Droid Army as a standard, [[Humanoid/Legends|bipedal]] [[B-series battle droid/Legends|B-series battle droid]],<ref name="TCW UK 6.26" /> standing at 1.91 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in height,<ref name="db" /> with black [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] and tan-colored plating.<ref name="TCW UK 6.26" /> As a [[Class four droid/Legends|class four droid]], Coppertop was designed for fighting,<ref name="SGtD">''[[Scavenger's Guide to Droids]]''</ref> his primary aim being to kill the enemies of the Confederacy.<ref name="TCW UK 6.26" /> To that end, he wielded an [[E-5 blaster rifle/Legends|E-5 blaster rifle]].<ref name="TCW UK 6.26" /><ref name="db" />

As a consequence of the activation of Order 99 during his service on Bogoa, Coppertop underwent a major personality change, and his primary aim became to ignore his old, combat-oriented programming and to come to the aid of weak and wounded beings instead. He believed that helping injured clone troopers&mdash;his former enemies&mdash;was the right thing to to, because the [[Human/Legends|Humans]] were treated as expendable in the same way that battle droids like himself were, and he gained an aversion to fighting and sought to resolve conflict through peaceful means.<ref name="TCW UK 6.26" />

The change in his programming caused Coppertop to gain a greater degree of individuality. He sought to live as a free droid rather than to serve the Droid Army, and felt that conviction to such an extent that he would rather deactivate himself than return to the Confederacy. In addition, he customized his appearance, gaining mandibles on the side of his face and a gold-colored crest atop his head. He also took to wearing a cape, and he marked his torso with an inverted red stripe.<ref name="TCW UK 6.26" />

==Behind the scenes==
Coppertop made his first and only appearance in ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]] in ''[[The Only Good Clanker]]'', a [[Star Wars comic books|comic strip]] written by [[Robin Etherington]] and illustrated by artist [[Will Sliney]], which was included in the [[October]] [[2011]] magazine ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic 6.26|Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic UK 6.26]]''. The comic was later reprinted in the publication ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Magazine 9]]''.<ref name="TCW UK 6.26" />
